errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your vault was not modified. Please try again.

welcome.tagline: Your passwords and private notes, encrypted on this device.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: No account, no server. Your vault never leaves your phone unless you export it.

encrypted.title: Encrypted before it is saved
encrypted.body: Everything you store is encrypted with a key derived from your master password (Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305).

private.title: No ads, no tracking
private.body: No advertising or analytics in the app. Nothing you store is ever sent anywhere.

master.title: One master password
master.body: Only you know it. Nobody can reset it or recover your data for you.

create.title: Create your vault
create.intro: Choose a master password. It unlocks your vault and encrypts everything in it.
create.passwordHint: Use a long passphrase you can remember, e.g. 4–6 random words.
create.noRecoveryTitle: A forgotten master password cannot be recovered
create.noRecoveryBody: SafeVault does not store your master password and has no server. If you forget it, the data in this vault cannot be decrypted — by anyone, including us. Write it down somewhere safe and export encrypted backups regularly.
create.understand: I understand that a forgotten master password means my data is lost
create.tips: Tip: do not reuse a password you use anywhere else.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.subtitle: Enter your master password to unlock.
unlock.biometricInvalidated: Biometric unlock was turned off because your device's biometrics changed. Unlock with your master password, then turn it back on in Settings.
unlock.wrong_one: Wrong master password. {{count}} attempt left before a waiting delay.
unlock.wrong_other: Wrong master password. {{count}} attempts left before a waiting delay.
unlock.lockedOut: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
unlock.error: The vault could not be opened. Your data has not been modified.
unlock.forgotten: Forgotten master password? It cannot be reset. You can only start over or restore a backup whose password you remember.

empty.title: Your vault is empty
empty.body: Add a login, a secure note, a card or an identity with the + button.

health.title: Vault health
health.good_one: Good. Local checks found {{count}} item to review.
health.good_other: Good. Local checks found {{count}} items to review.
health.empty: Add logins to see your password health.

item.decryptFailed: This item could not be decrypted. It may be damaged.
item.deleteBody: "{{title}}" will be permanently deleted from this device. Make sure you have a backup if you might need it.

edit.chooseType: What do you want to add?
edit.remaining_one: {{count}} of {{max}} left on the free plan
edit.remaining_other: {{count}} of {{max}} left on the free plan

card.disclaimer: SafeVault stores card details encrypted for your reference only. It is not a payment wallet and is not certified for payments (PCI DSS).
card.noCvvHint: For your safety, SafeVault never stores the security code (CVV) or the PIN.
card.noCvv: This looks like a CVV or PIN. SafeVault does not store them: please remove it from the notes.
card.luhnWarning: This number does not look valid. Check for a typo.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Tap to see items. Long-press to edit.
categories.editHint: Long-press a category to rename it, change its color or icon, or delete it.
categories.premiumHint: Custom categories, colors and icons are part of Premium.
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteBody: Its items are not deleted: they move to "Other".

generator.title: Generator
generator.excludeAmbiguousHint: Removes I, l, 1, O, 0, o and |
generator.disclaimer: Generated on your device with the system's secure random generator. The strength shown is an estimate, not a guarantee.

hints.avoid_common: This is a very common password

security.title: Security check
security.subtitle: Checks run on this device only. Your passwords are never sent anywhere.
security.empty: Add logins to check your passwords.

sections.weakBody: Easy to guess according to the on-device estimate. Replace them with generated passwords.
sections.reusedBody: The same password is used on these logins: one leak exposes all of them.
sections.oldBody: Not changed for more than {{days}} days.
sections.incompleteBody: Missing a password, or both username and email.

security.limitsBody: SafeVault does not check whether your passwords appeared in data breaches: that would require sending information to an external service. A good score does not mean your accounts are safe.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Auto-lock, clipboard, biometrics
security.autoLockHint: Lock the vault after this time in the background or without activity.
security.clipboardHint: Copied passwords are removed from the clipboard after this delay and when the vault locks.
security.biometricHint: Unlock with your fingerprint or face. The key is protected by Android's secure hardware. Your master password still works.
security.biometricFailed: Biometric unlock could not be enabled.

biometricUnavailable.no_hardware: This device has no biometric sensor.
biometricUnavailable.not_enrolled: Add a fingerprint or face in your Android settings first.
biometricUnavailable.insecure_device: Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) on your device first.

security.screenshotsHint: Prevents screenshots and screen recording, and hides the app content in the recent apps view.
security.rotateHint: Re-encrypts your whole vault with a new random key. Use it if you think your unlocked phone was compromised. Biometric unlock will need to be enabled again.
security.rotated: Your vault was re-encrypted with a new key.
security.deleteHint: Permanently erases all data on this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep it.
security.deleteBody: All items, categories and settings will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone.

changePassword.title: Change master password
changePassword.subtitle: Your data is re-protected with the new password
changePassword.intro: Your vault key is re-encrypted with the new password, with a new random salt.
changePassword.wrongCurrent: The current master password is wrong.
changePassword.backupReminder: Old backups keep the password they were created with. Export a new backup after this change.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.subtitle: Encrypted export and import
backup.explain: Backups are encrypted files. They contain no readable secret and can only be opened with the backup password.
backup.masterHint: Required to export. By default it is also the backup password.
backup.separateHint: Useful to give a backup to someone you trust.
backup.mergeHint: Merge adds missing items and keeps the most recent version of each item. Replace deletes the current content first.
backup.replaceBody: Everything currently in your vault will be deleted and replaced by the backup content. This cannot be undone.
backup.corruptedHint: These items cannot be decrypted (damaged storage). You can restore them from a backup, or remove them.
backup.purgeBody: {{count}} unreadable items will be permanently removed.
backup.risksBody: Anyone with a backup file can try to guess its password offline: use a strong one. If you forget the backup password, the backup cannot be opened.

errors.not_a_backup: This file is not a SafeVault backup.
errors.corrupted: This backup file is damaged or incomplete.
errors.unsupported_version: This backup was made by a newer version of SafeVault. Update the app first.
errors.tampered: This backup has been modified since it was created. It was not imported.
errors.too_large: This file is too large to be a SafeVault backup.
errors.import_failed: The import failed. Your vault was not modified.

restore.title: Restore a backup
restore.intro: Choose a .safevault file. It will be checked and decrypted on this device.
restore.verifiedBody_one: {{count}} item is ready to be restored.
restore.verifiedBody_other: {{count}} items are ready to be restored.
restore.chooseMaster: Now choose the master password for this device. It can be the same as before.

premium.historyCta: See the full history with Premium

about.title: Security & privacy
about.subtitle: How SafeVault protects your data
about.how: Your master password is never stored. When you unlock, a key is derived from it with Argon2id. That key decrypts the vault key, which encrypts each item separately. When the vault locks, keys are erased from memory.
about.kdf: Key derivation: Argon2id, {{m}} MiB, {{t}} passes, {{p}} lane(s), random 16-byte salt
about.cipher: Encryption: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (authenticated, 256-bit key, unique random nonce per item)
limits: A forgotten master password cannot be recovered.
On a rooted or infected phone, malware may read what you see while the vault is unlocked.
Screenshot blocking does not stop someone filming the screen.
SafeVault does not check data breaches.
SafeVault has not yet been audited by an independent security firm.
about.privacy: No account. No server. No ads. No analytics. No crash reporting. Your vault stays on this device. Purchases are processed by Google Play; they never include vault content.
